description: Validation of Seismic Design Provisions for Diaphragms and Assessment of Higher-Mode Responses on Earthquake-Resistant Buildings is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Georgios Tsampras, University of California San Diego (ucsd.edu). This publication provides a reproducible computational framework for processing and analyzing earthquake strong-motion data to evaluate seismic design provisions for floor diaphragms and higher-mode dynamic responses in earthquake-resistant buildings. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 1 top-level file. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-jnf5-e909. Keywords: Strong motion instrumentation data, Building Systems, Floor Diaphragms, Floor total accelerations, ASCE/SEI 7, Design code. Published 2025-04-02. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
